title: Will Playboi Carti release a new song before Nov 1, 2026? Before November
rules: If Playboi Carti releases a new song Before Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

blind.reasoning: Today is about Oct 18, 2026, so roughly two weeks remain. Carti's latest release was a guest verse on Fatt Smaxk's 'Smaxk Or Die' (May 22, 2026). The market is still open, so that apparently didn't count or came before the market was created. He releases solo music rarely and unpredictably, so a qualifying song in a short window is unlikely, though recent Opium activity and live shows leave some chance of a surprise drop or a feature that counts.
blind.falsifier: Playboi Carti puts out a new single, a surprise Opium group project, or a guest verse the market counts on streaming platforms before Nov 1, 2026.

final.reasoning: The market's 0.125 midpoint is below my earlier 0.22, and my research was incomplete, so I moved toward the market to 0.16. With the YES ask at 0.15, the remaining edge is too small to bet on given the uncertainty about whether features count.
